# Stand and Deliver: Toro Unveils Two Stand-On Platforms at Equip Expo


### Toro’s first dedicated stand-on blower plus a redesigned GrandStand® HDM+ on display at Equip Expo


Oct 14, 2026 |[Professional Contractor](https://newsroom.toro.com/en/professional-contractor)


-
-
-


Toro is standing up to the commercial landscaping industry’s toughest productivity challenges at Equip Expo in Louisville, Kentucky from October 20-23, with the rollout of two new stand-on platforms designed to help crews do more with fewer operators.


The AeroMaster™, Toro’s first dedicated stand-on blower, empowers landscape contractors to clear debris with more precision and speed than backpack or hand-held blowers. Plus, the popular stand-on GrandStand HDM+ gets a redesign that delivers increased power, agility and serviceability at a lower price tag to help landscape contractors combat rising operating costs without sacrificing efficiency.


“Designed directly with feedback from professional contractors, these new stand-on introductions put landscape pros in command of every job,” says Jackson Gray, product marketing manager at Toro. “By pairing high-volume power and operator comfort with superior terrain visibility, these new stand-on machines give contractors a versatile way to get more jobs done in their day — with fewer interruptions.”


**AeroMaster™ 8100 CFM Stand-On Turbine Blower**


Designed with Toro’s proven turbine technology, the AeroMaster produces the highest CFM in its category, delivering up to 30% more airflow* than competitors in the space. At 8,100 effective CFM, the AeroMaster easily moves wet, stuck-on debris, making large cleanup jobs in the spring, fall or after storms fast and manageable.


The clutched turbine design allows the operator to quickly disengage the blower without shutting off the engine, keeping debris from blowing into unwanted areas. For even greater precision, intuitive fingertip controls allow the operator to move the nozzle 180 degrees seamlessly, making it easy to adjust airflow direction on the fly to push debris away from hardscapes, fence lines, and flower beds.


The nozzle itself is built for flexible job-site durability, flexing on impact instead of cracking, so it holds up against the daily abuse of curbs, trailer ramps and commercial cleanups. When it is time to move to the next job, the flexible nozzle flips up for easier transport and a smaller footprint on the trailer. Additionally, the AeroMaster features a toggle front axle engineered to pivot smoothly over uneven terrain, minimizing machine vibration and enhancing operator comfort throughout long shifts.


**GrandStand® HDM+ Stand-On Mower**


Toro’s GrandStand Heavy-Duty Mini is getting a massive upgrade and a new — lower — price. The new GrandStand HDM+, available in 32-inch and 36-inch models, delivers a suite of major enhancements, including upgraded maneuverability, easier maintenance, and the highest horsepower in its category with a more accessible price.


Where competing compact mowers often compromise power and finish to meet a lower price point, the HDM+ combines a high-performance Kawasaki FX651V engine, Toro’s legendary TURBO FORCE® cutting deck and strategic, oversized front casters to ensure unmatched cut quality without sacrificing performance.


Designed for contractors seeking stand-on efficiency in tight areas, the HDM+ maintains a narrow footprint that navigates gated entries and tight property boundaries with ease. The oversized 13-inch x 6.5-inch front casters pivot smoothly to give operators enhanced maneuverability and a comfortable ride while protecting delicate grass from compaction and turf tear.


The HDM+ is engineered for maximum uptime and reliability with tool-less access panels to the back of the mower, allowing technicians fast access to the engine and transmission components.


**Horizon360** ®


**Business Management Software**


Both machines are equipped to integrate seamlessly with Toro’s business management solution Horizon360. This software helps landscape contractors drive more profits and increase business efficiency and effectiveness.


New features to the Horizon360 platform include:


- New Basic Tier: A new entry-level subscription option offers a lower-cost solution for contractors who only require essential management tools, such as streamlined invoicing and payment collection.


- Simplified Tracking Interface: The redesigned tracking page features a simplified interface that enables contractors to monitor their entire equipment fleet at a single glance.


- Enhanced Reliability: Updated tracking device firmware keeps equipment location and run-time data flowing continuously across all connected equipment.


- Upgraded Equipment Management: Refocused design efforts make setting up equipment, navigating fleet lists, and tracking preventive maintenance faster and more intuitive.


To see all of Toro’s offerings in person, stop by indoor booth 7148 and outdoor booth 7600D at Equip Expo, or visit[toro.com](http://toro.com/) for more information.
